notes: Correct, clean Token-helper fix with thorough segment-level tests (backticks, heredoc, follow-on directives), but it misses the quoted-token exemption on the 'site address ends with {' check that the reference added.
Essentially the reference fix with clean Token helpers but omits the quoted-token guard on the 'address ends with {' check; thorough dispenser and segment-level parse tests.

Covers every structural brace check the reference touches, including the quoted-address suffix and quoted '{}' fixes; however, the Dispenser-level helpers sit alongside inline checks in doImport, and the httpcaddyfile test `respond "{" "}"` oddly passes '}' as a status code.

Correct fix using Dispenser-level helpers with a bounds check, but doImport has to inline the checks, which is slightly inconsistent; tests cover dispenser, parser and adapter, though one adapter case relies on an odd status argument.
Essentially matches the reference: Token helper methods, quoted-address suffix guard and the '{}' restructuring are all present, with solid dispenser and parser tests (including backtick quotes).
Faithful to the reference, including the '{}' and address-suffix handling, with concise helpers and solid dispenser plus parse table tests.

Clean Token-method helpers applied everywhere the reference does, but it keeps the quoted check for '{}' inside the branch, so a quoted '{}' on a new line still skips the segment-break logic; the tests are excellent and include an adapt integration test for the issue's exact case.

Mirrors the reference with Token methods and the quoted address-suffix guard; it keeps the old quoted-'{}' branch, which still swallows a quoted '{}' at line start (minor), and it adds good dispenser, parse and adapt integration tests.

This fixes the root-only for_each case but still deduplicates by ConfigResource and module path, so a parent-module import silently drops every child-module import for that resource, even ones targeting other instances. That is why it fails 2 of the 3 hidden tests.

Fixes the same-module case from the issue, but it still deduplicates at the ConfigResource level across modules. A parent-module block for one instance therefore silently drops child-module blocks for other instances of that resource, the same class of silent drop the issue reports, which matches failing 2 of 3 hidden tests.

It matches the reference fix: it returns every import statement and deduplicates per resource instance at expansion time, so the first block wins and parent overrides child. It also adds an unrequested ctx-shadowing refactor and a defensive copy of the module path, and its test covers only the root for_each case.

Matches the reference design: it collects all import blocks unkeyed and deduplicates per instance during expansion, first-wins with parent blocks first, via a clean helper. It also adds two refactors the fix did not need (copying the module path to avoid slice aliasing, and replacing ctx reassignment with modCtx), which is mild scope creep but low risk.
